_schema.description: Coding standards and architectural patterns for PyDocSync: Deterministic code-documentation synchronization for Python codebases using the standard library only.

companion_standards.readme_standards_plan_note: Rules for writing Specifications (spec.md), Implementation Plans (plan.md), and Architecture Notes (ideas/arch_*.md). Future tense, Status field required, freeze on ship.
companion_standards.readme_standards_shipped_note: Rules for Module READMEs and Agent Quick Reference Cards.
companion_standards.constitution_note: Project governance and core invariants. In case of conflict, constitution wins over this file.

spec_kit_templates.note: spec-kit provides standard layouts for its own artifacts. Do NOT write these manually — use the slash commands.

writing_new_python_module.note: Every new module must have a standard four-part header docstring (WHAT IS THIS?, WHY DO WE NEED THIS?), full type annotations, and Google-style docstrings.

writing_classifier_rule.note: Rules must implement the standard ClassifierRule protocol, produce deterministic ChangeCategory outputs, and route unresolvable cases to UNKNOWN with review_required=True.

writing_test_file.note: Use pytest strictly with the local virtual environment (.venv). Never use arbitrary sleep calls; test empirical behavioral falsification.

updating_baseline_schema.note: Baseline lockfiles must use top-level envelope schema_version: 1 and support fallback deserialization for legacy flat formats.

pydocsync_library.header_docstring_format: Must include WHAT IS THIS? and WHY DO WE NEED THIS? sections.
pydocsync_library.zero_dependencies_rule: Strictly Python standard library only (ast, json, hashlib, dataclasses, pathlib, argparse). Zero external runtime dependencies allowed.

type_annotations.syntax: Python 3.10+ native syntax (e.g. str | None, list[dict[str, Any]]). Do not import Optional, Union, List, Dict from typing.
type_annotations.py_typed_marker: The package root pydocsync/ must contain a py.typed marker file.

docstring_standards.format: Google Style docstrings on all public functions, classes, and methods.
docstring_standards.parameters: Document Args, Returns, and Raises explicitly. Do not duplicate type hints in docstring parameter signatures.

scoped_gate.rule: During development, run pytest targeting only the modified test module (e.g. ./.venv/Scripts/pytest.exe tests/test_classifier.py).
scoped_gate.full_suite_rule: Run the entire test suite before marking any SDD feature or task converged.

rule_interface.protocol: Must evaluate RepresentationDiff and return ImpactClassification (HIGH_IMPACT, CANDIDATE_LOW_IMPACT, UNKNOWN).
rule_interface.fail_safe_rule: If dynamic mutation, aliasing, or unhandled AST nodes prevent deterministic safety evaluation, classify as UNKNOWN with review_required=True.

schema_versioning.validation: pydocsync accept must reject whitespace-only or blank reasons with exit code 2, and non-existent symbols with exit code 1.
